cards.title: Kashyyyk: Sacred Forest
issues: Dark side 'Unless Mosep on table, Force lost from your Force drains here must come from opponent's hand, if possible' not implemented (engine; OVS 1116_016 on master also omits it).

review.blocked_on: Engine: hand-first drain loss with Mosep exception (swccg-guild/work#182, no PR)
review.fix_instructions: Implement the hand-first drain clause after the engine hook, with tests (with/without Mosep, empty hand fallback).
review.notes: Start-of-turn draw per qualifying Kashyyyk site, once-per-turn Yarna download, all Nudjs lost: implemented and tested.

pc_front.gametext: Light: At start of your turn, may draw a card from Reserve Deck for each Kashyyyk site where all your ability is provided by Wookiees. Once per turn, may deploy Yarna d'al' Gargan from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Unless Mosep on table, Force lost from your Force drains here must come from opponent's hand, if possible. All Nudjs are lost.
pc_front.title: •Kashyyyk: Sacred Forest

cards.title: Reflection (V)
issues: '(cannot be reduced)' on the retrieved Force is not implemented; RetrieveForceEffect is plain.

review.blocked_on: Source-scoped 'this retrieval cannot be reduced' support (only a duel-wide flag exists on master; worker's request swccg-guild/work#182; no prerequisite PR).
review.fix_instructions: When available, mark this card's retrieval as not reducible and add a test with a retrieval-reducing card.
review.notes: Deploy on [Endor] Leia, training destiny +1, control-phase 3 Force (1 with Save You It Can) retrieve 1 implemented and tested.

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on [Endor] Leia. Leia's training destiny draws are +1. During your control phase, may use 3 Force (if Save You It Can on table, may use 1 Force instead) to retrieve 1 Force (cannot be reduced).
pc_front.lore: It was hard to imagine the enormous losses the Alliance suffered during the Battle of Hoth. Leia contemplated what she could do to help the Rebellion recover.
pc_front.title: •Reflection (V)

cards.title: A Jedi's Cunning
issues: 'opponent may not cancel immunity to attrition of your Jedi' (while Sidious or [Episode I] hologram on table) not implemented. Existing ImmunityToAttritionMayNotBeCanceledModifier only protects its source card and is not opponent-scoped.

review.blocked_on: Engine: filter-based, opponent-source-only version of ImmunityToAttritionMayNotBeCanceledModifier (swccg-guild/work#182, no PR)
review.fix_instructions: Add a constructor taking an affect filter plus a check that only opponent-sourced cancellations are blocked, then add the clause (your Jedi, conditional on Sidious/Episode I hologram) with a test.
review.notes: Both battle-destiny caps (sites with your Jedi under the condition; where Luke present) implemented and tested; Alter immunity tested.

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on table. While Sidious or an [Episode I] hologram on table, opponent may not cancel immunity to attrition of your Jedi and draws no more than two battle destiny at sites where you have a Jedi. Opponent draws no more than two battle destiny where Luke present. (Immune to Alter.)
pc_front.lore: Luke's sudden reversal of fortune allowed him to turn the tables on Vader.
pc_front.title: •A Jedi's Cunning

cards.title: Lieutenant Williams (V)
issues: 'if at opponent's system, may take other destiny into hand' not implemented (DrawDestinyAndChooseInsteadEffect has no hand option).

review.blocked_on: Engine: optional hand destination for the unchosen destiny in DrawDestinyAndChooseInsteadEffect (swccg-guild/work#182, no PR)
review.fix_instructions: Add the opponent's-system branch once the effect supports it, with a test at opponent's system (take the other card into hand) and at own system (no option).
review.notes: +2 power piloting, Radiant VII draws one battle destiny if unable otherwise, draw two choose one at a system here: implemented and tested.

pc_front.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Radiant VII, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle at a system, if about to draw a battle destiny here, may instead draw two and choose one; if at opponent's system, may take other destiny into hand.
pc_front.lore: Pilot of the Radiant VII. Was personally requested by Captain Madakor to assist in the transportation of the Jedi ambassadors.
pc_front.title: •Lieutenant Williams (V)
